in_hindi.long_meaning: जो हरि (विष्वक्सेन) और नारायण (विष्वक्सेन/कृष्ण) के सकारात्मक रूप है

in_marathi.name: Harinarayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Hari (God Vishnu) + Narayan (God Vishnu's Name)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harinarayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harinarayan is a compound name derived from Hari and Narayan. Hari is a name for Lord Vishnu, and Narayan is a name for Lord Vishnu as the supreme cosmic ruler. The name signifies the divine presence and protection of Lord Vishnu.
